title: Birthday commission: dad and toddler daughter
content: HELLOOO looking for an artist for a birthday comm!! all refs + details are below :D please feel free to offer if you’re cannn! i’d love to see your art, wooopp uuu! Image brief: LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST FOR A BIRTHDAY COMMISSION. SFW / personal use. 2 characters: daughter (2-3 y/o) + her dad (33-35 y/o). Half body for dad, full body for daughter. Flat color only, soft + warm colors. Manhwa / donghua style sketch, strong anatomy, handsome dad aura, wide back. Cute cheerful toddler, wholesome father-daughter vibe, birthday theme. Deadline: within 2 months. Please include commission price, examples of male characters / father figures, examples of children/toddlers if available, and estimated turnaround time. Can join waiting list if commission slots are full this month or currently closed. Available on Discord for discussion + progress updates (Discord QR on the post image). DNI if you sexualize minors, support proship/pedophilia/incest, are racist or queerphobic, support AI art/tracing/art theft, use minors for NSFW, ghost artists after confirming a commission, harass artists, or disrespect boundaries. Contact: reply on the post or Discord QR in the image.
